% Pattern: proof/attach/lettered. The main theorems are unnumbered
% environments with the letter in the title, and their proofs come at the
% end, after other statements, with the letter in the head.
% Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want thma-1 statement/theorem A status=here
% want thmb-1 statement/theorem B status=here
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1
% want proof-2 proof - proves=thmb-1
% want proof-3 proof - proves=thma-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem*{thmA}{Theorem A}
\newtheorem*{thmB}{Theorem B}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{thmA}
A statement.
\end{thmA}
\begin{thmB}
Another statement.
\end{thmB}
\section{Proofs}
\begin{lemma}
A helper.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
A step.
\end{proof}
\begin{proof}[Proof of Theorem~B]
By the lemma.
\end{proof}
\begin{proof}[Proof of Theorem A]
By the lemma too.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
